_doc: The long routine: test runners run periodically (machine file "routines": {"long": {...}}; passion: Saturday 10:00) by 'amps-nightly run --routine long', in this order. Same schema as runners.json (ORCHESTRATOR.md section 2); runner ids must differ from those of runners.json.

runners.title: srcSEP 2013-04-11 event inputs: prepare_event.py check
runners.note: regenerates every checked-in input of the SEP--event-2013-04-11 tests (derived.json, observations.csv, event.event, event.in, event.nightly.in, event.args, the WSO asset, deck_summary.json) from the raw archives and byte-compares them, so a change of the preparation script, its settings or the archives is caught; the Table tests themselves only read the checked-in files. The same check as the nightly runner sep-event-inputs, run with the long tests.

runners.title: MakefileTest/Table long tests (Tier=long, Makefile.test.long)
runners.note: the test list is 'make -s test_long_manifest'; add a long test as a MakefileTest/Table block with Tier=long and Ranks=<N> (run through $(TESTMPILAUNCH) $(TEST<name>RANKS)); 1920 min = the routine's time_limit_h of 32 h on passion
